description.text: Program highlight This programme offers students a thorough grounding in electrical and electronic engineering. Students will learn to operate at the cutting edge of emerging technologies.Teaching Objective By the time you graduate, you shouldhave extensive experience in modelling and analytical methods;be able to use IT tools and CAD systems for modelling, analysis, simulation and design;be able to design a system, component or process based on initial requirements and constraints. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Two blank pages of the passport( For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper.)

requirements.text: 1. Be in good health 2. High school graduate
